Reviewer: Mikes-Mac pool job review-4118, claude-sonnet-5-5, mkinney (bob) seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good
- The PR changes only 3 files: the `camcraft-mcp` skill, `crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs` and one decision file. No production code, tool schema, golden or UI changes.
- The skill now names `set_program` as shipped, links `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` and documents `camcraft-cli mcp reference` and `camcraft-cli mcp prompt`. The gap section keeps the `MCP: <command>` rule.
- The scanner does not treat prose such as "post" or "undo" as a tool name. A control test pins this and the section boundaries.
- `unwrap`/`expect` appear only in test code. The decision file `docs/decisions/1947-mcp-gap-drift.md` exists. The body has `Process change: yes` and does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #1947`.

## Results (locally, trial-merged with upstream/main de035b4; no GitHub runner used)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift`: 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: one step, `app:mcp_doc_drift`, the same suite.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none owed. The diff has no `testdata/` change and no importer change.
- Light, heavy, batch and release lanes: not run. The diff does not reach them.

## Mutations
Not run by the reviewer. The sandbox refused edits to the sensitive file `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. This is a docs and test PR, not a safety-tier change. The PR body reports the red run against the old skill (2 tests failed). The reviewer read the scanner code and found no logic fault.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The PR author is not mkinney, so the reviewer does not flag it ready (it is already not a draft).
- A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - process files (.claude/skills + xtask) change. Counted review at head adf68066 is clean (mkinney, 07:01:24Z). The merge remains the maintainer's call.
